headline: As of 2026-10-21: 14,358,466 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 42 of 50 states, D+16.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 14,358,466 early/mail ballots cast so far across 42 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+16.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (1,854,319), Florida (1,395,031), Texas (1,188,683).
